content: Project Alpha is on track for the frontend redesign. The new component library based on Tailwind CSS is 80% complete. Remaining work includes the settings panel migration and dark mode support. Target completion is end of sprint 14. No blockers identified.

Project Beta API migration is in progress. We have migrated 12 of 18 endpoints from REST to gRPC. The authentication middleware rewrite is blocking the remaining 6 endpoints. Performance benchmarks show 40% latency improvement on migrated routes. Expected completion: sprint 16.
